purpose: Bounded protocol follow-through for the public HMS Landeignaskra viewer proxy, based on the named-country recheck and existing safe samples.

sandboxFailureHistory.executionContext: restricted sandbox network; not an escalated public network request
sandboxFailureHistory.result: curl exit 6; HTTP 000; local resolver reported Could not resolve host: landeignaskra.hms.is
sandboxFailureHistory.interpretation: This was a sandbox DNS failure and does not establish endpoint unavailability.

viewerScript.observedGeometryLoader: OpenLayers extent is joined with commas and fetched at /api/geo/wfs/landeign?bbox=<extent>; the response is decoded by GeoJSON readFeatures. The loader declares id=landeign and strategy=bbox. This loader supplies no ID predicate, count, startIndex, page or limit parameter.

freshness.interpretation: The same four-feature body/hash recurred 58 seconds later. The response exposes no modification or cache validator, so this supports only short-interval count/body stability, not dataset publication freshness.

identity.nativeIdentifierTypeObserved: integer JSON value; normalized to string in the durable safe sample
identity.viewerFeatureIdentityLogic: The current viewer's setId uses ae:<AE_SKIKI_NR> when present; otherwise ln:<LANDEIGN_NR>:<SKIKI_AUDK>. GeoServer Feature.id is a separate MV_LANDEIGNASKRA_TINY.fid value. Therefore LANDEIGN_NR names the land unit but is not sufficient as the viewer's polygon-part identity when SKIKI_AUDK distinguishes pieces.

knownSampleGeometryRecheck.method: The same bounded anonymous bbox response was compared in memory by LANDEIGN_NR to each already-retained full geometry.

knownIdQueryAttempt.requestParameter: LANDEIGN_NR=221261, together with the same bbox
knownIdQueryAttempt.interpretation: The parameter did not narrow the bbox response; it is not a verified exact-ID lookup.

nativeShapedAbsenceQueryAttempt.requestParameter: LANDEIGN_NR=999999999, together with the same bbox
nativeShapedAbsenceQueryAttempt.interpretation: The parameter did not narrow or empty the bbox response. This is not an absence result.

pagingProbe.parameters: count=1&startIndex=1, together with the same bbox
pagingProbe.interpretation: Standard count/startIndex parameters had no effect. The viewer and observed route expose bbox retrieval only; server cap and pagination remain unsupported/unverified.

axisAndOutput.response: GeoJSON-like FeatureCollection with explicit legacy crs.name=urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3057
axisAndOutput.coordinateOrderObserved: [x,y] in native projected easting/northing ranges; no WGS84 reprojection was applied in this proxy response.

qualification.anonymousGeometryAndBboxRead: verified for this bounded Reykjavik window
qualification.knownNativeIdGeometry: known sample geometries reappeared within the same bbox; exact-ID lookup is not verified
qualification.explicitAbsentId: not verified; the only tested native-ID parameter was ignored
qualification.pagingAndServerCap: not verified; count/startIndex were ignored in the bounded probe
qualification.datasetFreshness: not verified; count and body were stable across two reads 58 seconds apart, with no bbox modification validator
qualification.widerCoverageOrRuntimeAdmission: not established by this protocol check
